title: Demo: one joke deck, every comedy platform
caption:
DEMO POST 🧪 — Joke Junction pipeline check, not a regular post.

One joke spec in, every connected comedy platform out:

1. Instagram @jokejunction.ai (this post)
2. LinkedIn (Joke Junction profile)
3. Reddit (u/joke_n_junction)

Facebook skips until a Page is connected to the Joke Junction workspace. Telegram, YouTube and Bluesky stay off for this niche on purpose — they belong to the business account.

If you are seeing this on more than one comedy account at once — the joke machine works.
